title: Trace context propagation and SLI calibration for analytics pipelines
creator: Jamal Whitaker
description: Add end-to-end trace propagation across the analytics ingestion and query pipeline and produce calibrated SLIs/SLOs for Console usage analytics. This ticket covers changes to producer SDKs, ingestion workers, enrichment services, Kafka consumers, metrics export, and dashboards so that we can attribute latency and errors to the correct tenant/workflow and operate reliable alerting
acceptance_criteria: All critical ingestion and query services emit traces with a single trace-id that can be followed from SDK -> producer -> Kafka -> consumer -> enrich -> storage -> query
SLI definitions published in team's runbook and config stored in metrics service: ingestion success ratio, processing lag (95th), pipeline end-to-end p99 latency, query p99 latency per-tenant
Dashboards exist showing per-tenant and global SLI/SLO trends, with alerting rules wired to PagerDuty and Slack channels
Sampling strategy implemented: high-volume tenants sampled to avoid trace overload but metrics remain accurate for SLIs
Migration plan executed: 10% canary -> 50% -> 100% with automated validation checks and rollback hooks
Runbook entries for common failure modes and remediation steps are added to Confluence with links to dashboards and drilldowns
tasks: Instrument producer SDK to propagate trace context (W3C Trace-Context) and attach tenant metadata
Patch ingestion API gateway to forward incoming trace headers to downstream processors
Update Kafka producer/consumer wrappers to preserve trace-id across message boundaries
Add trace/span instrumentation to enrichment and dedupe workers (critical path) and mark them as 'analytics.ingest' spans
Export traces to Jaeger/Tempo with the same trace-id and enrich with tenant_id and dataset tags
Emit SLI metrics (counters + histograms) from consumer after final write step with labels for tenant_id and route
Create dashboards in Grafana for ingestion lag, processing success ratio, p50/p95/p99 latencies per-tenant and global
Define Prometheus alerting rules for SLO breaches and error-budget burn, wire to pd-team-analytics Slack/PagerDuty
Implement adaptive sampling: sample 100% traces for slow/error requests, sample 1% for healthy high-volume tenants
Run canary traffic using test tenant and automated validation harness for 48 hours, then promote
implementation_plan: Phase 0: Design and SLI definitions (this ticket) — finalize metrics & trace schema
Phase 1: SDK & gateway changes + unit tests — deploy to staging and run integration tests
Phase 2: Kafka wrapper and worker instrumentation — deploy to canary cluster with synthetic load
Phase 3: Metrics export and dashboarding — initial dashboards in staging, smoke alerts configured
Phase 4: Gradual rollout and validation — 10% -> 50% -> 100% with rollback criteria
Phase 5: Post-rollout tuning — calibrate thresholds, update runbooks, and deprecate old ad-hoc dashboards
notes: We must avoid high-cardinality label explosion in Prometheus by limiting tenant label cardinality on some metrics; use tenant buckets for large customers and full tenant_id only on debug spans
Tie SLI computation to the same time window as billing and console usage reporting to avoid conflicting signals
Consider integration with Redwood Optimize signals to correlate SLO regressions with recent model/quantization changes
Cross-team coordination required with infra (Kafka retention and consumer groups), platform security (header forwarding policy), and support for PagerDuty escalation paths
